inputs.label: Half-Life 2
inputs.help: Your installed copy of Half-Life 2 from Steam. QGPUI copies the hl2 and platform folders.

inputs.label: Half-Life 2: Episode One (optional)
inputs.help: Your installed copy of Episode One. QGPUI copies the episodic folder.

inputs.label: Half-Life 2: Episode Two (optional)
inputs.help: Your installed copy of Episode Two. QGPUI copies the ep2 folder.

inputs.label: Portal (optional)
inputs.help: Your installed copy of Portal from Steam. QGPUI copies the portal folder. Portal also needs Half-Life 2's files.

steps.why: The guide has the user grant file permissions on the first launch.
The guide launches the app once before copying the game files.

steps.text: Open SourceVRPort from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for file access, allow it. Choose your game and press Play once the content check reports ready.

notes: Steam app IDs come from the payload's store links. The payload gives the episodes' Steam paths as "Half-Life 2 Episode One/episodic/" and "Half-Life 2 Episode Two/ep2/", but current Steam installs may put episodic and ep2 inside the Half-Life 2 folder, so no installDir is set for them. The guide does not say whether the episodes also need hl2. Assumes a glob like hl2/** keeps paths below hl2/. Releases also carry SourceVRCore-*.apk and Pico builds; the guide installs only SourceVR-<version>.apk and the pattern excludes the others. Granting the appop over adb is not yet tested on a Quest.
